title: Operators and Expressions
overview:
This chapter introduces arithmetic and comparison operators. You will learn how to add, subtract, multiply, divide, compare values, and build simple logical expressions.

Learning goals:
- +, -, *, /
- %, <, >, ==
- booleans

Why it matters:
Programs are built from expressions and decisions. Operators help us model real-world rules.

Example:
price = 50
discount = 10
final_price = price - discount
print(final_price)

Think about this:
How do we compare numbers in Python?
exercises: Print the result of 12 divided by 6.
Check whether two numbers are equal and print the result.
